The founding of the Indian National Congress

questions.q: Parakram Diwas is observed every year on January 23. Whose birth anniversary does it commemorate?
questions.explain: Parakram Diwas, or 'Day of Valour', marks the birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, born on 23 January 1897 in Cuttack. In 2026 the nation observed his 129th birth anniversary, with main celebrations held at Sri Vijaya Puram in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: ISRO's first launch of 2026, the PSLV-C62 mission carrying the EOS-N1 satellite, ended in failure on 12 January 2026. Which stage of the rocket developed the anomaly?
questions.explain: The PSLV-C62 lost control during the third-stage burn, the same stage that had failed in the earlier PSLV-C61 mission of May 2025. It was the first time the reliable PSLV 'workhorse' suffered two consecutive failures, with 16 satellites lost.

questions.q: In the context of space technology, what is 'ISRO’s Gaganyaan-1' mission primarily tasked with?
options: Uncrewed test flight for human spaceflight
questions.explain: Gaganyaan-1 (G1) is the first uncrewed test flight of the programme. It carries the humanoid robot Vyommitra and is meant to make sure all the safety and life-support systems work perfectly before we actually send our astronauts up there.

questions.q: The 'Digital Personal Data Protection Act' (DPDPA) rules were finally notified this month. Which authority is now the primary regulator for data breaches?
questions.explain: The Data Protection Board of India is the body you need to know. They’re the ones who will handle complaints and investigations if a company mishandles your personal data.

questions.q: Which Indian city has once again been named India's 'Cleanest City' in the latest Swachh Survekshan rankings, retaining the top spot for the eighth consecutive time?
questions.explain: Indore just won't give up the top spot! It has been ranked India's cleanest city for the eighth consecutive time, setting such a high standard for waste management that it's become the gold standard for other cities across the country.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: As we observe National Voters' Day today, January 25, 2026, can you recall which constitutional body is responsible for conducting the elections in India?
questions.explain: It's the Election Commission of India, a permanent constitutional body established way back in 1950. National Voters' Day is celebrated every year on this date to mark its foundation and encourage more young voters to take part in our democracy.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is India's targeted annual green hydrogen production capacity by 2030 under the National Green Hydrogen Mission?
questions.explain: Launched in 2023, the National Green Hydrogen Mission targets at least 5 million tonnes (MMT) of green hydrogen production per year by 2030, alongside about 125 GW of new renewable energy capacity, to make India a global hub for green hydrogen.

questions.q: Which country currently holds the rotating Presidency of the G20 for the year 2026?
questions.explain: The United States assumed the G20 Presidency for 2026 (effective 1 December 2025), taking over from South Africa, which held the 2025 presidency. The 2026 G20 Leaders' Summit is scheduled to be hosted in Miami, Florida.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: In the world of space exploration, the 'Lunar Gateway' project is a collaborative effort led by NASA. Which other agency is a key partner in this station orbiting the Moon?
questions.explain: ESA is playing a huge role alongside NASA. Think of the Lunar Gateway as a sort of space station base camp near the Moon, which will help astronauts head down to the lunar surface more efficiently.

questions.q: Under its flexible inflation targeting framework, the RBI is mandated to keep retail (CPI) inflation at what level?
questions.explain: Since 2016, the RBI follows a flexible inflation targeting framework under which it must keep Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation at 4%, within a tolerance band of +/- 2% (i.e., between 2% and 6%). The Monetary Policy Committee sets the repo rate to meet this target.

questions.q: The Padma Awards 2026 were announced on 25 January 2026. Who among the following was named for the Padma Vibhushan, the country's second-highest civilian award?
questions.explain: Veteran actor Dharmendra was among the five Padma Vibhushan awardees announced for 2026, conferred posthumously. The 2026 list comprised 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri awards.

questions.q: The 'Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam' has been in the news for its implementation status. What does this landmark Act primarily guarantee?
options: Reservation of seats for women in Lok Sabha and Assemblies
Mandatory female recruitment in armed forces
questions.explain: This act is a game-changer for our legislative process. It's all about ensuring that women have a stronger voice in policy-making by reserving one-third of the seats in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies.

questions.q: Which technology giant recently announced new partnerships with Indian state governments and a grant to Wadhwani AI to expand AI literacy among India's students and teachers?
questions.explain: Google announced AI-education partnerships with several Indian states and a Google.org grant to Wadhwani AI, aiming to reach tens of millions of students and educators across India. It's great to see a global tech leader investing in students' digital literacy.

questions.q: What is the primary theme of the 2026 Republic Day parade in New Delhi?
questions.explain: The theme of Republic Day 2026 was '150 Years of Vande Mataram', marking 150 years since Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay composed the national song in 1876. Tableaux and performances along Kartavya Path were built around this theme.

questions.q: The 'Extended Producer Responsibility' (EPR) principle, central to India's Plastic Waste Management Rules, places the responsibility for managing post-consumer plastic waste primarily on whom?
questions.explain: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) makes producers, importers and brand owners responsible for the environmentally sound management of plastic packaging through its end of life — for instance by collecting back and recycling an amount equivalent to what they place on the market.
